calls.statement:
SELECT 
  SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON r.return_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.category = 'Garden'
  AND p.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17;

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  r.return_date,
  p.product_name,
  COUNT(*) AS return_lines,
  SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON r.return_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.category = 'Garden'
  AND p.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17
GROUP BY r.return_date, p.product_name
ORDER BY r.return_date, p.product_name;

  SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON r.return_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.category = 'Garden'
  AND p.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17;
